faq_heading: Homes near St Bernadette: your questions answered

faq.q: Does living near St Bernadette get a child a place?
faq.a: No. St Bernadette is an independent school and sets its own admission, so distance does not decide it. Ask the school how applications and wait lists work.

faq.q: How does the St Bernadette home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions St Bernadette. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near St Bernadette sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 277 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,248,000, townhomes $720,000, condos $478,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near St Bernadette?
faq.a: Within 2 km of St Bernadette the median was 32 days on the market, closing at 96.5% of the list price, with 11% of sales above the list price for the 277 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to St Bernadette?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (0.4 km south-east), Martha Jane Norris Elementary (0.5 km north-west) and Henry Bose Elementary (0.6 km east).

St Bernadette is an independent school in Surrey, at 13130 65b Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names St Bernadette. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 2 km of the school.
How the St Bernadette search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names St Bernadette, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of St Bernadette sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 277 homes sold within 2 km of St Bernadette: 135 houses, 113 townhomes and 22 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,248,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of St Bernadette

31 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of St Bernadette in a straight line (23 elementary, 6 secondary, 2 other; 5 independent). The closest is Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Strawberry Hill Elementary, 2.7 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Martha Jane Norris Elementary (0.5 km); the nearest independent school is iLearn Secondary School Society (1.2 km). Other elementary schools close by: Martha Jane Norris Elementary (0.5 km north-west), Henry Bose Elementary (0.6 km east), Panorama Park Elementary (0.9 km south-west), North Ridge Elementary (1.0 km south-east), W E Kinvig Elementary (1.0 km north). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Martha Jane Norris Elementary, 0.5 km north-west of St Bernadette.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near St Bernadette

items.t: Ask St Bernadette how admission works. A short distance does not give a child a place.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near St Bernadette are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.
Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 2 km of St Bernadette was $1,248,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Martha Jane Norris Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.5 km north-west of St Bernadette. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
